title: Microsoft launches its first AI model for cybersecurity, MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, with superior performance and lower cost
summary: The system achieves 95.95% accuracy in threat detection with half the operating cost of similar models.

title: A 16-hour Xbox server outage prevents playing even physical titles
summary: The outage, caused by a licensing issue, affected three generations of consoles and reignited the debate on the digital future of video games.

title: ASRock and Sapphire introduce the Radeon RX 9050 with 4GB and 8GB VRAM configurations
summary: AMD's new entry-level graphics card based on RDNA 4 comes with 4GB and 8GB options and a power consumption of only 100W.

title: China begins mass production of its own DUV lithography machines for chip manufacturing
summary: The new ultraviolet lithography machines will be delivered to major Chinese chipmakers like SMIC, CXMT, and Hua Hong starting in 2026.

title: MSI and Colorful increase NVIDIA RTX 50 prices by up to 59% in China
summary: The price increase for RTX 50 series graphics cards in China suggests that similar hikes could soon reach other markets.

title: Moonshot AI releases open-source model Kimi K3 with performance close to frontier models
summary: The Chinese AI model Kimi K3 offers performance nearly on par with the best from OpenAI and Anthropic at a significantly lower computational cost.

title: Claude shared chats exposed in Google and Bing search results
summary: A privacy flaw allowed private user conversations to appear in search engines, reigniting concerns about data confidentiality in AI services.

title: Amazon requests authorization to deploy 5,105 mobile satellites to compete with Starlink
summary: Amazon's satellite network, called Leo, will offer 5G coverage from space with a constellation of more than 5,000 satellites.

title: Anthropic CEO clarifies his stance on open-weight models and expresses concern about Chinese AI
summary: Dario Amodei states he is not opposed to open models but warns about the risks of AI advancing in China without controls.

title: Zero-day vulnerability in Artifactory allowed exploitation of OpenAI models before Hugging Face breach
summary: The incident underscores the importance of rapid patching and raises questions about the security and control of AI models.

title: Nvidia forms Open Secure AI alliance with 37 members after security flaw in an OpenAI agent
summary: The alliance, which does not include OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic, aims to improve AI security through open standards.

title: Framework Laptop 13 Pro reviews highlight significant battery improvement but higher price
summary: The modular laptop offers better energy performance and remains repairable, although its cost has increased considerably.

title: Mod adds DLSS and Frame Generation to Mirror's Edge 17 years after release
summary: The modding community has added support for AI upscaling technologies to the classic first-person parkour game.

title: Xbox owners receive PC versions of 13 Ubisoft games at no extra cost
summary: Titles like Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, and others are available for free to those who already own them on Xbox.

title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro will integrate AI upscaling and frame generation in games
summary: The new AI Frame Fusion feature combines AI techniques to improve graphics quality and increase FPS on mobile devices.

title: Intel Core 2 Duo turns 20 as the processor that marked the end of the Pentium 4 era
summary: The launch of the Core 2 Duo in 2006 returned leadership to Intel and laid the foundations for modern processors.

title: Microsoft Surface Laptop with 8GB RAM freezes with basic multitasking according to multiple reports
summary: Several reviews show that the 1,000 euro model with 8GB RAM suffers freezes during everyday tasks, suggesting insufficient memory.

title: Elon Musk launches X Money, the banking service in the US with 6% APY for X Premium subscribers
summary: X's financial services platform offers high-yield savings accounts with high annual interest for paying users.

title: Apple releases security updates for macOS Tahoe 26.6 and other operating systems
summary: The new versions fix critical vulnerabilities in all Apple devices, including macOS and iOS.

title: Nvidia employee arrested in Taiwan for alleged chip smuggling to China
summary: The investigation for falsification of commercial documents is part of increasing scrutiny on technology exports to China.
